extractedBy: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5), agent pack POC session
notes: Picked over AccountCard for the pilot: BenefitCard's headerItems and items take typed BenefitCardItem rows with their own leading and trailing slots, it has four node slots (header, bodyHeader, children, button), and it cascades modes into composed ListItem, Nudge and Button children. Evidence was checked on the installed build (0.1.78-c1fa197, 13 October 2026). The guide names no other component to use instead. Updated 17 October 2026 for a116616: #271 (dead Close on the upsell) and #280 (a pressable card nested its buttons) are fixed, so their gaps and the 'avoid onPress while the card has a button' rule are gone.

examples.purpose: A plan card with its own earnings rows, perks and an upgrade button.
examples.jsx:
<BenefitCard
  headerTitle="You will earn"
  headerItems={[
    { icon: 'ic_jewellery_diamond', title: 'JioPoints', trailingText: 'Up to 2000 pts' },
    { icon: 'ic_offer', title: 'Cashback', trailingText: 'Up to ₹5000' },
  ]}
  items={[
    { icon: 'ic_card', title: 'Zero forex markup on cards' },
    { icon: 'ic_support', title: 'Priority support, 24/7' },
  ]}
  buttonLabel="Upgrade"
  onButtonPress={() => {}}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}
/>

from.quote: “JioPoints” with “Up to 2000 pts”, two perks, and “Upgrade”.

evidenceFacts.description: Defaults to two placeholder rows; children wins over items.

evidenceFacts.name: bodyHeader
evidenceFacts.description: Defaults to the upsell Nudge; null or false removes it; a node replaces it.
evidenceFacts.quote: `bodyHeader` (default upsell Nudge; `null`/`false` removes it; a node replaces it)

evidenceFacts.name: button
evidenceFacts.description: Replaces the call to action; null still renders the default button, so hide it with showButton false.
evidenceFacts.quote: `button` (replaces the CTA; `null` still renders the default)

evidenceFacts.name: onPress
evidenceFacts.description: Since a116616 the header becomes a Pressable button named by accessibilityLabel, else headerTitle, else bodyTitle; the lists become a pointer-only press region with no role or Tab stop, and each dims to 0.92 opacity while pressed. With showHeader false the lists are the button. The upsell and the card's button are siblings, not children.
evidenceFacts.quote: since a116616: the header becomes a Pressable button named `accessibilityLabel ?? headerTitle ?? bodyTitle`, and the lists a pointer-only press region with no role or Tab stop

evidenceFacts.name: modes
evidenceFacts.description: Cascades to the card's children, each over its own defaults: rows (List Item Style Minimal, Nudge padding None), icons (AppearanceBrand Secondary), figures (Text Sizes Small, Weight Regular), the button (Button / Size S) and the upsell (AppearanceBrand Neutral). A consumer AppearanceBrand overrides all three brand defaults at once.
evidenceFacts.quote: A consumer AppearanceBrand overrides all three defaults at once.

evidenceFacts.name: AppearanceBrand
evidenceFacts.description: Recolours the icons, the upsell and the button; no mode changes the card's surface or title.
evidenceFacts.quote: No mode changes the card's surface or title.
